line: How do you roll a square out of circles? Spinning circles stack into a square wave, until a dive into one corner finds the 9% spike that never goes away.
line_cn: 方方正正的波，怎么由圆滚出来？一个个圆叠成方波，直到镜头扎进一个角：那里有一个永远消不掉的 9% 尖角。

camera.move: Push onto a rotation, then ride a moving point
camera.serves: one term, one phasor, one particle

camera.move: Match cut between two curves of the same shape
camera.serves: a circle's arc to a wave crest; a trajectory to a graph

camera.move: Pull back over a whole curve
Dive into a detail (×10 and more), graticule refining, TIME/DIV shrinking
camera.serves: an error, a crossing, a limit

transitions: Transitions come from the medium: letters morphing into the next subject;
labels: Instrument voice: a monospace (e.g. JetBrains Mono, OFL) for readouts, cursors, knob values, labels on objects, 19–30 px. Values are live (computed every frame); align the = signs in a column.

Formula: TeX typography (MathJax SVG paths or LaTeX), top left, about 520–560 px wide; glyphs are lit one by one by the beam; the part that changes (an upper limit, a coefficient) flashes when it changes.

Titles: a serif that matches TeX (e.g. STIX Two Text, OFL), 60–84 px, with the key word in italic; a Chinese line under it in a CJK serif (e.g. Noto Serif SC) ≥ 34 px. Written by the beam (outline traced, then filled, then a white-hot flash), never faded in.

Subtitles: bottom left, fixed to the glass, a thin vertical light bar, Chinese serif 36 px over English STIX italic 29 px, one line each, a soft dark scrim behind them so a trace never runs through the words. Keep subjects and labels out of that corner.
motion: Rotation is uniform and real (the frequencies are the maths). Growth eases in: a new element grows from nothing at the point it attaches to in about 0.45 s, flashing white (in our demo, a new circle at its parent's tip).
Additions accelerate rather than repeat: one, then a few, then too many to count.
Live values update every frame; when a value is the point, it is shown at the precision that stays constant.
STOP freezes the signal; the camera may keep moving through the frozen world.

native_moves.name: Epicycle chain
native_moves.does: circles on circles whose tip draws a curve, with afterglow.
native_moves.fits: Fourier series; phasors in AC circuits; planetary epicycles.

native_moves.name: Live readouts
native_moves.does: values computed from the drawn state, updating every frame.
native_moves.fits: a pendulum's energy; a filter's gain; a running sum.

native_moves.name: Text into geometry
native_moves.does: a title written by the beam, its letters morphing into the next subject.
native_moves.fits: naming a theorem before it appears; a chapter title becoming an axis.

native_moves.name: Knob zoom
native_moves.does: a dive with refining graticule and changing scale readouts.
native_moves.fits: the fine edge of a fractal; a discontinuity; numerical error near a limit.

native_moves.name: Cursor measurement
native_moves.does: (amber): two lines, an arrow, the difference and its share.
native_moves.fits: a period; a rise time; a peak height.

native_moves.name: STOP and power-off
native_moves.does: freezing the signal for a closer look; collapsing the picture to a dot at the end.

score.note: plucked synth tones following the signal, sine bells for events
